name: Wan Zhijian
current_role: Vice Chairman (from Oct 2026), director and deputy GM, Nanchang Sanrui Intelligent Technology (301696.SZ)
profile: Wan Zhijian (b. Feb 1979) is co-founder and ~18.7% shareholder of Nanchang Sanrui Intelligent Technology, a leading maker of electric propulsion systems (motors, ESCs, propellers) for drones and robot joints, also developing eVTOL power systems. He co-founded the firm in 2009 with his cousin, chairman Wu Min; it listed on ChiNext in April 2026.
interesting_fact: Sanrui sits on two Chinese policy themes at once - the low-altitude economy (drone power systems, ~49% of revenue from exports) and embodied-AI robotics via its CubeMars robot-joint brand launched in 2018; gross margin on main business was about 60% in 2025.
deep_cut_fact: Before drones, Wan spent a decade (July 1998 - June 2008) running an earth-and-stone haulage business, then joined his cousin's Nanchang Sanrui Technology as deputy GM in 2008. He studied rural economics at the Jiangxi Provincial Party School.
notes: Elected vice chairman of the 2nd board on 27 Oct 2026 (cninfo 1225629729). Bound by concert-action agreement with Wu Min (cousin, controller). No personal public profile; route via company IR.
